events.title: Rob Pike and Ken Thompson publish UTF-8 design
events.summary: Rob Pike and Ken Thompson published the UTF-8 encoding plan in September 1992 — the text encoding underlying the modern web and JSON.
events.about: UTF-8 let ASCII-compatible systems handle Unicode without breaking existing software. Every API, database, and browser today assumes UTF-8 as the default string encoding.

narrative.whyChosen: UTF-8 is the universal text encoding of the internet.
narrative.whyImportant: It enabled global software without abandoning ASCII infrastructure.
narrative.problemSolved: Fixed-width Unicode encodings wasted space and broke Unix text tools.
